runtimeImplementation: src/core/KernelSymbolProfile.h, ServiceTable.h, Win32kDispatch.h and Win32kDispatchProfile.h; this document cannot enable additional images
scope: Native descriptor validation is required. Enumerates populated session slots without switching debugger context. Follows the reviewed thunk to its first implementation; subsequent implementation calls are outside scope. Unsupported session decoding retains entry thunks with a coverage gap.

sessionDispatch.index: Session zero uses the inline slot; session ID >= 1 uses highSlots[ID - 1]
sessionDispatch.routeProfiles: src/core/Win32kDispatchProfile.h: 1499 reviewed RVAs, lengths, API host/target offsets, imports, names and SHA256 digests
sessionDispatch.codeValidation: Full thunk SHA256 with declared external rel32 fields normalized. External call destinations must also match; direct tail jumps are compared with their import slot.
sessionDispatch.null: A verified NULL terminal is Not registered; unreadable pointers and changed code remain unknown
sessionDispatch.stability: Session count, slot array, session roots, API tables and host bindings are rechecked after enumeration
sessionDispatch.conditionalFallback: Service thunk RVA 0x18910 can call watchdog!SMgrNotifySessionChange when the primary target is NULL or returns STATUS_INVALID_SYSTEM_SERVICE

filteredTable.codeValidation: Exact normalized wrapper template; all service IDs, relative references and per-service import bridges must agree
filteredTable.rejectionReturn: Sign extend the per-service byte; positive values return 0xc000001c
filteredTable.scope: Conditional first implementation call, predicate, handler and possible rejection return. Does not evaluate per-process filter policy or execute the service.
